zh.title: 规则
zh.drag: 拖动顶部可将规则栏移出，成为独立窗口

zh.applied: 当前规则已加入最近一次任务请求。

en.title: Rules
en.drag: Drag the header out to open an independent window
en.placeholder: Enter a rule; press Enter for a new line
en.hint: One rule per line · Autosaved · Empty uses native behavior
en.saveFailed: Could not save rules. Retry before sending.
en.conflict: Rules changed elsewhere. Retry to save this editor's version.
en.hookFailed: Rules injection is unavailable. Re-enable Rules.
en.applied: Current rules were attached to the latest task request.
en.nativeFailed: The detached editor could not start. The in-page floating editor remains available; dock it and retry.
